bio: Northern Finland: aurora nights, frozen lakes and husky sleds. Cold is a good teacher.
avatar: Portrait of a man in his 40s with frosty eyebrows and a fur-lined hood, northern lights glowing green behind him, smiling, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of green northern lights over a frozen lake and a small cabin with warm lit windows, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Aurora over the frozen lake
videos.description: Green curtains dancing above the ice.
videos.still: Wide photograph of vivid green northern lights over a frozen lake with snowy pine trees and stars, no people, no text
videos.motion: The aurora ripples and shifts overhead, stars twinkle, slow gentle camera push-in.

videos.title: Husky team at dawn
videos.description: Breath clouds, harnesses and a sled starting to move.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a team of huskies in harnesses pulling a sled across snow at dawn with breath clouds, a musher seen from behind, no face, no text
videos.motion: The huskies run forward, breath clouds puff, snow sprays up, steady camera follow.

videos.title: Sauna, then snow
videos.description: Steam, a wooden bench and a lake hole in the ice.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a wooden lakeside sauna cabin with steam and a ladder leading into an ice hole in a frozen lake, blue twilight, no people, no text
videos.motion: Steam drifts from the sauna door and fine snow falls, slow camera push-in.

videos.title: Snow falling on the cabin
videos.description: Chimney smoke, warm windows and silence.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a small log cabin in a snowy pine forest at dusk with warm windows and smoke from the chimney, falling snow, no people, no text
videos.motion: Snow falls gently, chimney smoke curls upward, windows glow, slow gentle push-in.

stories.caption: Frozen breath
stories.still: Vertical photograph of frost crystals on a wool scarf in cold morning light, no face, no text

stories.caption: Thermos, ice fishing
stories.still: Vertical photograph of a small hole in the ice on a lake with a fishing line and a thermos, no people, no text

stories.caption: Sky tonight
stories.still: Vertical photograph of green aurora ribbons over snowy pines, no people, no text
